texts.orig: The Outback has become a go-to setting for crime thrillers. Ina drought-scourged country town; a charismatic local priest guns down five men. A year on, troubled journalist turns upto write a piece on the anniversary of the murders; and discovers that a seemingly open-and-shut case is anything but. Scrublands is well-plotted and atmospheric; but theres almost too much going on as it explodes into life.
